plaatsen.tekst: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep

For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified
Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
